ValidationRule.description: Blocks the legacy CPQ Send with Adobe Sign path (sets ASSFCPQ__Quote_Document__c) on quotes in Subscription Order Form scope. The Order Form Send for Signature service never sets that field. Bypass: custom permission Order_Form_Guard_Bypass.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED( ASSFCPQ__Quote_Document__c ) ), NOT( ISBLANK( ASSFCPQ__Quote_Document__c ) ), ASSFCPQ__Quote_Document__r.SBQQ__Quote__r.Order_Form_Scoped__c, NOT( $Permission.Order_Form_Guard_Bypass ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This quote is in Subscription Order Form scope. Close this page, open the quote and press Send for Signature: it sends the same document with the right checks and writes the customer's PO and VAT back. Questions: the CRM team.
